crossComponentAnnotations.annotation: DATA COLLECTION ONLY. Learning algorithms moved to rpc-api (repos/metabob-rpc-api/server/db/operations/impulse_learning.py). Raw data sent to backend via MCP tool metabob_learning_record_turn. Architectural boundary: opencode collects, rpc-api learns.

LEARNING ALGORITHMS. Receives raw turn data from opencode via POST /record-turn. Performs pattern extraction (normalize_pattern), quality calculation (calculate_quality), usage tracking (track_usage). Persists to SurrealDB. Single source of truth for learning data.

VESSEL FLOW. Forwards raw turn data from opencode to rpc-api. Maintains architectural consistency with instance-invariant-storage spec (opencode → MCP → rpc-api → SurrealDB). Abstraction layer for backend swappability.
